title: Shares climb in Asia, and South Korea’s Kospi hits a record close, in an upbeat start to 2025
summary: BANGKOK (AP) — Asian markets began 2026 with gains, with South Korea’s benchmark closing Friday at a record high, while U.S. futures and oil prices also advanced. Optimism over the future of artificial intelligence has carried over into the new year, driven by expectations that it will spur demand for computer chips and other items […]
